description: What INFORMATION_SCHEMA contributes to container-scoped listings: the schema holds exactly 62 views and no tables, a database-wide SHOW VIEWS counts them beside the user's own (63) and SHOW OBJECTS both kinds (64) while SHOW TABLES counts only user tables; the schema row itself is owned by nobody with its fixed comment among 3 schemas; every system view is a VIEW owned by nobody (no owner role type) where a created object names its owner; and SHOW COLUMNS is asserted as a floor (user columns only - the recorded gap in docs/scope.md). Totals asserted exactly, live-verified on both sides. Converted 1:1 from ddl/InformationSchemaListingTest (now retired).
